text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0872, Motion / Motion Response]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE FORWARDED THE FOLLOWING DUE TO ABSENCES:]
APPROVE Motion by Padilla, Bass, Ayala, Horvath, and Barger that the Board direct the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	Prepare a First/Last Mile plan for the Sun Valley Metrolink Station with a Transit Oriented Development (TOD) Vision study focused on the redevelopment potential of underutilized industrial parcels in Sun Valley and along the San Fernando Road industrial corridor, coordinated with the Brighton to Roxford Double Track Project; 

B.	Evaluate whether improvements identified for the former Sylmar Light Rail Transit station in the 2020 ESFV Light Rail Transit Project's First/Last Mile plan are applicable to the Sylmar Metrolink Station; based on the results of the Shared Right-of Way Study; and 

C.	Establish early coordination on the design and construction schedule of the Brighton to Roxford Double Track Project with the California High-Speed Rail Authority's Palmdale to Burbank selected alignment through Sun Valley. Develop recommendations that preserve design flexibility and experience for riders.
